definition.title: The Sograt Letter
definition.description: An original desert-road story using a small Ragnarok-inspired setting sample; no source text is included.

scenario.setting: This small journey connects five places: Prontera, Morroc, Morroc Market, the Pyramid, and Sograt. A courier's note has gone missing between the capital road and the desert, and people remember only fragments of the handoff.
scenario.startingSituation: At a quiet gate in Prontera, a guard asks for help tracing a sealed letter. The route passes through Morroc and Morroc Market, then toward the Pyramid and the open stretch of Sograt.
scenario.worldRules: Use only details present in this original scenario and the player's actions; do not assume outside canon or game mechanics.

items.name: Sealed letter
items.description: A plain envelope closed with a blue wax mark.

items.name: Route strip
items.description: A narrow paper strip with five place names.

items.name: Water flask
items.description: A leather flask filled for a long walk.

items.name: Linen wrap
items.description: A folded square of clean linen.

items.name: Bronze token
items.description: A small token with a simple notch on one edge.

items.name: Travel bread
items.description: A firm loaf wrapped in paper.

items.name: Ink pot
items.description: A tightly corked pot of dark ink.

items.name: Quill
items.description: A trimmed feather ready for writing.

items.name: Canvas satchel
items.description: A light bag with two outside pockets.

items.name: Brass lantern
items.description: A hooded lamp with a steady handle.

items.name: Lamp oil
items.description: A sealed bottle for the brass lantern.

items.name: Market receipt
items.description: A short receipt with a blank note line.

items.name: Spare button
items.description: A dark button that can fasten a travel coat.

items.name: Cotton cord
items.description: A coil of soft cord for tying bundles.

items.name: Dry fruit
items.description: A small pouch of sweet dried fruit.

items.name: Chalk piece
items.description: A white piece for marking a safe turn.

items.name: Folded map
items.description: A blank map sheet folded into quarters.

items.name: Wooden spindle
items.description: A small spindle polished by frequent use.

items.name: Blue ribbon
items.description: A narrow ribbon tied around a package corner.

items.name: Clay cup
items.description: A simple cup with a small repaired crack.

player.name: Rin
player.description: A careful traveler who prefers asking before guessing.

npcs.name: Edrin
npcs.description: Keeps a small delivery ledger beside the Prontera gate.
privateKnowledge: Edrin once copied a courier's route by mistake.

npcs.name: Sava
npcs.description: Checks travelers arriving along the Morroc road.
privateKnowledge: Sava has seen a blue mark on a package this week.

npcs.name: Nima
npcs.description: Sells useful travel goods at Morroc Market.
goals: find the owner of an unclaimed receipt
privateKnowledge: Nima tucked a paper tag beneath the counter.

npcs.name: Teren
npcs.description: Waits near the path leading toward the Pyramid.
privateKnowledge: Teren found a loose ribbon near the trail marker.

npcs.name: Ami
npcs.description: Knows a few shaded rest points across Sograt.
privateKnowledge: Ami heard someone ask after a letter at dawn.

npcs.name: Vero
npcs.description: Prepares simple meals for a small road caravan.
goals: keep the group supplied with water
privateKnowledge: Vero lent a clay cup to a courier yesterday.

npcs.name: Piri
npcs.description: Carries short errands between market stalls.
privateKnowledge: Piri remembers which stall had a crowded queue.

actions: Ask Edrin to read the courier ledger for the sealed letter.
Compare the letter's blue wax mark with the route strip.
Ask whether the courier left through the Morroc road.
Travel to Morroc and speak with Sava at the gate.
Show Sava the blank map sheet and ask for directions.
Visit Morroc Market and look for a matching paper tag.
Ask Nima whether the unclaimed receipt has a note on it.
Offer Piri the spare button in exchange for a careful description.
Buy lamp oil and refill the brass lantern.
Write the market details in the field notes.
Walk toward the Pyramid path and find Teren.
Ask Teren if a blue ribbon was left by the trail marker.
Mark the shaded rest point on the folded map.
Share a piece of travel bread with the road group.
Continue across Sograt with Ami's route advice.
Ask Ami when the courier was last seen near the rest point.
Show Vero the clay cup and ask who borrowed it.
Tie the blue ribbon around the sealed letter's satchel.
Return to Prontera and report the route to Edrin.
Ask Edrin to record what happened to the letter.
